war_summary: Day 95 of War 139, no winner yet. The map is heavily polarized: many regions are fully swept by one side (Colonials hold most southern/eastern hexes; Wardens hold Reaching Trail, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, etc.), while a handful of contested hexes carry nearly all the fighting. The hottest fronts are Callahan's Passage (extreme casualty rates, ~900-1200/hr and accelerating), Clahstra (heavy fighting with 15 base events in 24h), Onyx (evenly split 3-3, 17 events, very high casualties), Oarbreaker (most event-dense: 39 events in 24h across Posterus, Grisly Refuge, Partisan Island), Endless Shore (Woodbind churn, 14 events), Mooring County (Borderlane churn, 19 events), plus Olavis Wake and Stlican Shelf showing recent heavy but cooling action. Casualty rates are accelerating broadly across the active fronts while quiet regions show only trickle enlistments. Uncertainty: the packet's per-base event windows are limited to ~13h of history, several hot regions show zero events in the last 2h despite high casualties (possible lulls or stalemates at town-tier defenses), and enlistment surges everywhere suggest fresh manpower arriving whose effect on base ownership is not yet visible.
